function.name: edit_file
function.arguments:
{"path": "config.txt", "content": "# /boot/firmware/config.txt
enable_uart=1
# Enable the ARM I2C bus (/dev/i2c-1) and expose i2c-dev.
dtparam=i2c_arm=on
"}

text: Fixed: I2C was not enabled. Added dtparam=i2c_arm=on to the firmware config; reboot and modprobe i2c-dev so /dev/i2c-1 appears.
